rows.text: At the sitting of 19 May 1995 the President of the Assembly reads a letter from the President of the Republic dated 'Paris, le 18 mai 1995', sent under Article 18 of the Constitution and signed JACQUES CHIRAC, and the message it transmits, which says 'la façon dont s'est opérée la transition d'un septennat à l'autre' shows the continuity of the institutions.

locator.item: 2 - Message de M. le Président de la République

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-23 only (Président de la République, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff). Election rounds, the Constitutional Council's proclamation, its publication, the investiture ceremony, a stated start of term, an outer limit and any stated end stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Prime ministers, ministers, party offices and the President of the Senate's interim office are excluded.
